walls.note: Pedestal south face and the figure in profile (aimed view artifacts/landmark-refs/rembrandtmonument/pano-a.jpg); pose and costume from Rijksmuseum print RP-P-1933-342 (CC0).

items.where: standing bronze/iron figure of Rembrandt in 17th-century dress on the pedestal cap, weight on one leg, right foot forward
items.how: figure kit (figure-kit.ts): standing pose, weight on the right leg and left foot forward, hands crossed at the belt, beret, doublet skirt and six gilt buttons, 2.8 m figure; no facial modelling

items.where: heavy cloak over the left shoulder falling across the body and over the left forearm
items.how: one extruded cloak silhouette on the left shoulder beside the figure; folds are not modelled

items.where: tree stump behind the left leg carrying the painter's palette, a portfolio and a scroll
items.how: builder: stump box with a tilted disc palette, a flat portfolio slab and a cylinder scroll

items.where: square grey granite pedestal: stepped plinth, die, moulded cap, about 3.1 m high
items.how: builder: four stacked boxes plus cap, edges at the panorama-measured proportions

items.where: a dark inscription plaque on the die of each face
items.how: dark plates set 6 cm proud of the die; the front plate carries REMBRANDT in raised stroke lettering (the photographs show a script signature)

items.where: the Night Watch bronze group (Dronov and Taratynov, 2006-2012): 22 life-size figures after the painting on individual steel plates on the plaza in front of the statue
items.how: 22 figures from the kit in their plan positions (captain and lieutenant stepping out, ensign with the flag, two girls, boy, drummer, loaders, pikemen, halberdier, sword-raiser), props as rods; plan read from Commons photographs (Txllxt CC BY-SA 4.0, Hippolyte CC BY-SA 3.0); faces and costume detail are not modelled
items.seenIn: Commons: Rembrandt Monument ... 3D Night Watch ... 1.jpg; Nachtwacht-in-3D.jpg

walls.note: Seen from the north through the bus shelter: figure from behind, the same pedestal die with plaque.

items.where: low granite platform with a black-stone coping around the statue, grass lawn before it, a flight of shallow steps on the east side
items.how: one 11 x 6.5 m platform slab with a dark coping band; the shallow steps (0.15 m risers) and the lawn are omitted

walls.note: East side from the south-east: the figure from the rear left, the steps of the terrace.
West side from the south-west: the figure seen from the front-left with the stump at its left.
